bear_assumptions: USD 10.60 forward book value per share at 4.0x as net-deposit growth slows, trading and cryptocurrency weaken, credit and compliance costs rise, and premium returns normalize; customer assets and segregated cash are not treated as distributable equity.
base_assumptions: USD 11.50 forward book value per share at 6.0x as deposits, subscriptions and transaction products grow, normalized profitability remains strong, regulatory capital stays ample, and book value compounds despite stock compensation and convertible debt.
bull_assumptions: USD 12.50 forward book value per share at 9.0x as asset gathering, product breadth, international scale, capital returns and high normalized returns on equity persist without a material regulatory, credit, custody or market-structure setback.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary evidence restores the required expected return, base upside, downside payoff and margin of safety while net deposits, book value, regulatory capital and normalized per-share earnings remain supported; downgrade on persistent net outflows, material customer loss, regulatory-capital pressure, custody or cybersecurity failure, adverse payment-for-order-flow, crypto or event-contract restrictions, structurally higher credit losses, or dilution and acquisition spending that prevent book-value compounding.
